content:
We prove by induction that \(a_n=n-2\) for all \(n\ge 4\).

Base case: \(a_4=2=4-2\).

Assume for some \(n\ge 5\) that \(a_{n-1}=n-3\). Then
\[
a_n=\left\lfloor \sqrt{n(n-3)}\right\rfloor.
\]
Now
\[
(n-2)^2=n^2-4n+4 < n^2-3n = n(n-3)
\]
for \(n\ge 5\), and
\[
n(n-3) < (n-1)^2=n^2-2n+1.
\]
Thus
\[
n-2<\sqrt{n(n-3)}<n-1,
\]
so
\[
\left\lfloor \sqrt{n(n-3)}\right\rfloor=n-2.
\]
Hence \(a_n=n-2\).

Therefore,
\[
a_{2017}=2017-2=2015.
\]

\boxed{2015}
